Decision 2026-09-05: reconcile the paper's Metal figures to the single 19:16Z stamp rather than keep two stamps in one file. The hand-typed dedup/length numbers came from the Issue #10 comment at 12:02Z (837 concepts, single-stream 324/3/0.9%, aggregate 780/65/7.7%) while reliability came from Issue #17 at 19:17Z. Replay at 19:16Z gives single-stream 376/3/0.8%, aggregate 832/65/7.2%, length table over 889 concepts, recall/derive denominator 346, write calls 247. The 12.0% swarm headline is unchanged. Same precedent as commit e9a4395 which did this for CUDA.

J3 latency claim VERIFIED at the release binary over real stdio MCP (2026-08-20, SQLite store, 20 calls, median): against the rig's live llama.cpp BGE-M3 q8_0 on CPU, a lambo_derive ack went from 14.111 ms (base 166a3c8, synchronous) to 0.048 ms (J3). That 0.048 ms is at or BELOW the same binary's ack against FixtureEmbedder (0.076 ms), which is what 'the embedder is no longer in the call' means. Both runs applied all 21 concepts, so the fast number is not a fast no-op. The absolute figures differ from the doc's 27 ms warm derive because that was the dogfood client stack on pinned 3039b82; the delta is what J3 owns.
